name: SaaS Hub: Ready-Made Projects
tagline: Instant SaaS applications for your restaurant or cafe, built by expert Software Engineers.
description: A marketplace platform where business owners can purchase and deploy ready-to-use software (like digital menus, POS, and reservation systems) directly from the engineers who built them.
faq_seed: How do I contact the engineer who built this?
Can the app be customized for my cafe?
Will this integrate with my current POS?
Is this a monthly fee or a one-time project purchase?

policies.refund: Marketplace purchases are simulated in this prototype. Review the listing terms and contact the engineer about refund or support terms before purchase.
policies.schedule: Apps are ready to deploy; delivery timing and any setup work are agreed with the listed engineer.
policies.prerequisites: No technical experience is required to browse or purchase. Confirm your business requirements and integrations with the engineer.
policies.certificate: No course certificate applies. Ownership, licensing, and usage rights are specified in each project listing.
